_note: Citation trail for the design-repo. Source-dependent citations degrade to WARNINGS (never failures) when no sibling source tree is present. `measuredQuotes` pin each citation's content so an in-range-but-wrong line is caught when the source IS present.

sourceProject.name: merlin-clone
sourceProject.liveUrl: https://www.merlin.computer (a real company's marketing site; this repo is a snapshot of a LOCAL CLONE of it)
sourceProject.stack: React 18 + Vite 5 + react-router-dom 6 (lazy per-route code splitting), framer-motion 14, GSAP 3 (ScrollTrigger). Tailwind v3 is installed but DISABLED: tailwind.config.js sets corePlugins.preflight=false and src/index.css has no @tailwind directives, so design tokens come from the original compiled CSS custom properties and computed values, not from a Tailwind config.

liveSource.summary: REAL, LIVE COMPANY SOURCE. Copy, logos, felt-character art, photographs, product screenshots and brand marks belong to Merlin or third parties. This design-repo is NOT for public redistribution; the asset-role contract (assets/asset-roles.json) bans reproducing real third-party logos, the Merlin marks, real people's photos, real product screenshots and recordings.

placeholderCopy.summary: The clone's long-form text is deliberately ORIGINAL placeholder sized to live word counts: manifesto essay + handwriting overlays, /privacy + /terms bodies, blog post bodies, pricing FAQ answers, the blog-index handwritten aside. The design-repo carries structure and maxWords budgets only; the bundled example uses short structural UI copy plus neutral placeholder prose of its own. NOT placeholder (live copy present in the clone): the 5 home FAQ answers, the Gmail preview email body, routine/notification/transcript demo text - the design-repo records only their word budgets.

localStandIns.summary: FAQ ask form -> client-side mock (no /api/faq); /download installer links and iframe -> /download-stub.txt (the real installer host is never contacted); no analytics; no outbound requests.

perRouteCssIsolation.summary: ORIGINAL compiled CSS is used verbatim; each route lazy-imports its own ordered stylesheet list (see templates/routes.json routeStylesheets). Specificity ties are decided by order. Class names - including CSS-module hashes such as blog_page__bLGfe - are LOAD-BEARING: the CSS selects them literally (#top.blog_page__bLGfe .blog_...), so they must be reproduced exactly.

constraints.text: The clone makes no outbound requests and runs no analytics: ask form is a local mock, installer links go to /download-stub.txt. A PageSpec may not contain http(s) URLs (rule NO_EXTERNAL_REQUESTS; schema pins installerSource to local-stub and apiMode to local-mock).
Real company's content and brand assets; do not publish this repository or its zip.
`*` falls back to Home and an unknown /blog/<slug> Navigates (replace) to /blog; both are routing behaviors recorded in templates/routes.json `behaviors`, not templates.
PageSpec has no token/style override field (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21): styling is owned by section contracts.

evidenceLevels.derived-from-source: Read from src/ only (routing fallbacks), never measured on the live site.
evidenceLevels.derived-histogram: Counted by extraction/derive_histograms.py from the compiled CSS.

wordCounts.summary: maxWords = the MAXIMUM observed count (no headroom) from recorded live counts and the clone's own data; re-derived independently by the build (node import of the data modules, python over blog-posts.json). verify_all.py recomputes the blog maxima when the source is present.
